title: The endocannabinoid system and the ageing brain
title_zh: 内源性大麻素系统与老年大脑
abstract: Ageing is accompanied by a progressive decline in homeostatic resilience that increases vulnerability to chronic disease, disability and cognitive impairment. Although unhealthy brain ageing can often be prevented by managing the underlying risk factors, the molecular, cellular and physiological mechanisms that connect risk factors to late-life brain dysfunction remain incompletely understood. This review examines the role of the endocannabinoid system in brain ageing. The endocannabinoid system is a short-range lipid signalling network that helps to maintain neuronal, glial, metabolic and inflammatory homeostasis. Endocannabinoid signalling follows a dynamic lifespan trajectory, with relatively high activity during early adulthood and functional decline during ageing. Genetic or pharmacological disruption of endocannabinoid system activity impairs several processes linked to hallmarks of brain ageing, including neuroinflammatory control, adult neurogenesis, synaptic plasticity, cognitive performance, metabolic regulation and epigenetic stability. Conversely, low-dose Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) treatment can ameliorate several ageing-related brain phenotypes in old animals. However, clinical evidence in older humans remains limited, and the therapeutic potential of cannabinoid-based interventions requires further evaluation. Age-related changes in endocannabinoid system (ECS) activity might contribute to the decline in cognitive function observed during ageing. In this review, Andreas Zimmer discusses how evidence from genetic and pharmacological studies in mice and humans indicate that relevant cognitive functions may change as a result of changing ECS activity.
abstract_zh: 衰老伴随着主稳态韧性的渐进性下降，增加了慢性疾病、残疾和认知障碍的易感性。尽管通过管理潜在危险因素通常可以预防不健康的大脑衰老，但将危险因素与晚年大脑功能障碍相连接的分子、细胞和生理机制仍然未完全阐明。本综述探讨了内源性大麻素系统在大脑衰老中的作用。内源性大麻素系统是一种短程脂质信号网络，有助于维持神经元、胶质细胞、代谢和炎症的主稳态。内源性大麻素信号在生命过程中呈动态轨迹，早成年相对活跃，衰老期间功能下降。内源性大麻素系统的基因突变或药理学干扰会损害多个与大脑衰老典型特征相关的过程，包括神经炎症调控、成年神经发生、突触可塑性、认知表现、代谢调节和表观遗传稳定性。相反，低剂量的Δ9-四氢大麻酚（THC）治疗可缓解老动物体内多种与衰老相关的大脑表型。然而，老年人类的临床证据仍然有限，大麻素干预的治疗潜力需要进一步评估。大脑内源性大麻素系统（ECS）活性的年龄相关变化可能有助于解释衰老过程中认知功能的下降。在本综述中，安德烈亚斯·齐默尔讨论了来自小鼠和人类的遗传和药理学研究证据，表明相关的认知功能可能因ECS活性的变化而发生改变。
